package.name: easyfleet_easynav_collaboration_deployment
package.description:
A two-robot deployment scenario combining the "easynav" and "collaboration" ones: robot_1 and robot_2 each run a real EasyNav navigation stack (easynav_system system_main + this workspace's easyfleet_easynav_deployment navigation capability, reused as-is -- two instances, one per robot, namespaced), plus one fake/mock capability each -- robot_1 carries perception, robot_2 carries manipulation (own copies of the PerceptionFakeCapability/ ManipulationFakeCapability reference implementations, mirroring easyfleet_fake_collaboration_deployment's own duplication of these classes rather than sharing them). Both robots run against the same Gazebo world/map (easynav_playground_kobuki's playgorund_multirobot_kobuki.launch.py + src/easynav_indoor_testcase's home2 map), each namespaced to match its actual spawn namespace and initial pose. Also ships the example mission script built on easyfleet_mission_manager and the launch files and JSON/parameter configuration each robot is started with.
See the sibling package easyfleet_easynav_collaboration_simple_api_deployment for the exact same scenario written against easyfleet_core::Deployment's simpler API instead of this package's own hand-rolled lifecycle dance.
